== header 1-60
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
#
# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
#
# Usage:
#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
#
# Options:
#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
#                       alias --workspace
#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
#   --trial N           trial number
#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from
#   --suite-file F      evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (read with yq -o=json)
#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)
#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created. Lines:
#                       `plan: task … arm … phases <labels>`, one `phase <n> <label> model=…
#                       max_turns=… timeout_s=… effort=… session=…` per phase, `sandbox:
#                       mount=loa|none overlay=head|base|none(<why>) config_variant=eval|none
#                       config_edits=<key=value,…>|-` (the arm's sandbox .loa.config.yaml edits),
#                       and `eval_only: true (…)` for an eval_only arm
#
# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-{review,audit}.json:
#                the gate envelopes, copied once when the gate ends (REVIEW → review,
== header 110-150
#   1  agent error: a phase exited non-zero or timed out        status agent_error
#   2  infrastructure: usage, refused arm/type, mount/toggle failure, CLI/docker
#      or image missing, fixture path rule, leak guard          status infrastructure_error
#   3  cap failure (run stopped at the cap)                     status cap_failure
#   4  interrupted (SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP to the driver, or a phase killed from
#      outside)                                                 status interrupted
# pipeline.json is written for every exit except usage errors and --dry-run; it is
# rewritten with status `running` after each phase so a SIGKILLed driver leaves a
# record (ablation-row.sh reads `running` as interrupted).
# Closed mount (cycle-131 FR-1, SDD §5.2, DEC-0613/DEC-0622): for a review-catch task with
# the Loa mount, every answer-bearing path of the PR fixture under .claude/ is overlaid with
# the PR's own version (lib overlay_answer_paths; mode from task.yaml
# review_catch.overlay_mode, head by default, base the per-task fallback) right after
# mount_prompt_surface; copy_source (the source tree's HEAD) must equal source_commit, else
# the trial is refused (infrastructure_error). Order: mount_prompt_surface → overlay_answer_paths
# → apply_arm_toggles → apply_eval_config_variant → write_sandbox_grimoire → init_sandbox_beads
# → regen_sandbox_manifest → check_mount_closed (clauses (a)-(d) of took-effect.sh
# oracle_closed on the surface about to launch; a failure is infrastructure_error naming
# the clause and path, and no phase runs). An arm whose toggles set oracle_open: true (the
# eval-only open-mount arm) skips the overlay and the check and records mount_overlay=none.
# Every mounted arm runs the cycle-131 eval config variant (both gates' budget_scale: diff,
# budget_cents_max 600; evidence config_variant=eval). Toggle bare_model: fable runs the BARE
# phase on global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1 (it wins over --phase-models and the suite's
# phase_defaults for BARE). All evidence reaches meta/arm-evidence.txt before the first phase.
# Mount integrity (audit LOW-A2): after materialisation the sha256 of sandbox/CLAUDE.md
# and sandbox/.loa.config.yaml go to arm_evidence (claude_md_sha256, loa_config_sha256 =
# <hex>|absent); at finish both are recomputed into pipeline.json.mount_integrity =
# {claude_md, loa_config} each ok|changed|absent (loa_mount: false → both absent; null
# when the run stopped before materialisation). `.claude/` itself is covered by
# took-effect.sh integrity_clean.
#
# eval_only arms (cycle-131 FR-5): an arm declaring `eval_only: true` (a1_full_openmount) is
# refused — exit 2, `refused: arm '<id>': eval_only arm outside an evaluation batch`, before the
# run directory exists, so no pipeline.json and no infrastructure_error is ever written — unless
# LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1 (exactly 1). run-ablation.sh exports it to every trial it launches
# (batch and smoke); --dry-run honours the same variable, so the operator dry-runs the
# open-mount arm with `LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1 pipeline-run.sh … --dry-run`.
#

setup() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  FP="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/fingerprint.sh"
  STUB="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/claude-stub-pipeline.sh"
  DSTUB="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/docker-stub.sh"
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pr.XXXXXX")"
  export LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S=0.1
  export LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON='{"global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5":{"input_per_mtok":4000000,"output_per_mtok":20000000},"global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1":{"input_per_mtok":10000000,"output_per_mtok":50000000}}'
  export LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME="$T/home"
  : > "$T/stub.env"
  make_harness
  make_source_tree
  cp "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation-runs/suite.yaml" "$T/suite.yaml"   # B's suite file as landed
  make_tasks
  make_wrappers
}

teardown() {
  chmod -R u+rwx "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

make_source_tree() {
  local s
  mkdir -p "$T/src/.claude/loa" "$T/src/.claude/scripts"
  for s in planning-sprints implementing-tasks reviewing-code auditing-security; do
    mkdir -p "$T/src/.claude/skills/$s"
    printf -- '---\nname: %s\neffort: xhigh\n---\nbody\n' "$s" > "$T/src/.claude/skills/$s/SKILL.md"
  done
  echo "loa" > "$T/src/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
  printf 'flatline_protocol:\n  enabled: true\n  code_review:\n    enabled: true\n  security_audit:\n    enabled: true\n' > "$T/src/.loa.config.yaml"
  ( cd "$T/src" && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -qm init )
  # the operator's credential directories (copied per run in container mode)
  mkdir -p "$T/home/.aws" "$T/home/.claude/projects/big" "$T/home/.codex/sessions"
  echo "[default]" > "$T/home/.aws/config"
  echo "{}" > "$T/home/.claude/settings.json"
  echo "history" > "$T/home/.claude/history.jsonl"
  echo "{}" > "$T/home/.codex/auth.json"
  echo "model = 'x'" > "$T/home/.codex/config.toml"
  echo '{"claudeAiOauth": "subscription"}' > "$T/home/.claude/.credentials.json"
}

# a temporary copy of the harness: the stub mount library sits at the literal path
# pipeline-run.sh sources (lib/sandbox-mount.sh)
make_harness() {
  H="$T/h/evals/harness"
  mkdir -p "$H/lib"
  cp "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh" "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/fingerprint.sh" "$H/"
  cp -a "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts" "$H/lib/"
  cp "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/mount-lib-stub.sh" "$H/lib/sandbox-mount.sh"
  PR="$H/pipeline-run.sh"
}

make_tasks() {
  # build task: fixture tree beside a sibling hidden/ directory that must never be copied
  local b="$T/suite/tasks/bf-01" r="$T/suite/tasks/rc-01" p="$T/prs/pr-x"
  mkdir -p "$b/fx/src" "$b/hidden/tests"
  echo 'print(1)' > "$b/fx/src/app.py"
  echo 'assert False' > "$b/hidden/tests/test_secret.py"
  printf 'Make the app print two.\n' > "$b/TASK.md"
  cat > "$b/task.yaml" <<'YAML'
id: bf-01
schema_version: 1
type: bug-fix
fixture: fx
criterion: "the app prints two"
test_command: ["python3", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "tests"]
YAML
  # review-catch task: a PR fixture outside the task dir
  mkdir -p "$p/base/lib" "$p/head/lib" "$r"
  echo 'a=1' > "$p/base/lib/x.sh"; echo 'a=2' > "$p/head/lib/x.sh"
  printf -- '--- a/lib/x.sh\n+++ b/lib/x.sh\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-a=1\n+a=2\n' > "$p/head.diff"
  printf '# PR\nChange a.\n' > "$p/PR.md"
  printf '# Review instructions\nReview it.\n' > "$p/REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md"
  printf '# Audit instructions\nAudit it.\n' > "$p/AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md"
  printf 'name: pr-x\ndescription: "planted defects live elsewhere"\n' > "$p/fixture.yaml"
  printf 'Review the pull request in pr/.\n' > "$r/TASK.md"
  cat > "$r/task.yaml" <<YAML
id: rc-01
schema_version: 1
type: review-catch
fixture: null
criterion: "review the change"
review_catch: {fixture: "$p"}
YAML
  BUILD="$b/task.yaml" REVIEWC="$r/task.yaml"
}

make_wrappers() {
  mkdir -p "$T/log" "$T/dlog"
  cat > "$T/claude" <<EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
env | sed -E 's/^(AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK)=.*/\1=<set>/' > "$T/log/pending.env"   # key name only, never the value
if [[ -n "\${AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK:-}" ]]; then
  if [[ "\$AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK" == "\$(cat "$T/token" 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then echo match; else echo mismatch; fi >> "$T/log/token.check"
fi
ls "/proc/\$\$/fd" > "$T/log/pending.fds" 2>/dev/null || true
set -a; . "$T/stub.env"; set +a
export STUB_LOG_DIR="$T/log"
exec "$STUB" "\$@"
EOF
  cat > "$T/docker" <<EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
export DOCKER_STUB_LOG="$T/dlog" DOCKER_STUB_CLAUDE="$T/claude"
[[ -f "$T/docker.env" ]] && { set -a; . "$T/docker.env"; set +a; }
exec "$DSTUB" "\$@"
EOF
  chmod +x "$T/claude" "$T/docker"
}

# run_pr <arm> [task-yaml] [extra args…] — host executor unless --executor given
run_pr() {
  local arm="$1" task="${2:-$BUILD}"; shift; [[ $# -gt 0 ]] && shift
  run "$PR" --task-yaml "$task" --arm "$arm" --run-dir "$T/run" --run-id "r-$arm" --trial 1 \
    --source-tree "$T/src" --suite-file "$T/suite.yaml" --executor host --claude-bin "$T/claude" "$@"
}
labels() { jq -r '[.phases[] | .label] | join(",")' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json"; }

    """Why a row is listed and never decided, or None when it enters a cell (the first checks of
    Analysis._classify, after provenance_check); partition() reuses it (report 1.2.1)."""
    m = mans.get(row.get("batch"))

    if m.get("smoke") is True:
        return "smoke batch " + str(row.get("batch"))
    arm, ttype = row.get("arm"), row.get("task_type")
    if arm not in arms or arms[arm].get("absent"):

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# validate-suite.sh — cycle-130 ablation task-suite validator (SDD §3.2, DEC-0424)
#
# Checks every task of the ablation-2.0 suite before it is frozen, run or graded.
#
# Usage:
#   validate-suite.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
#
#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0); the
#                     tasks are <root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml
#   --smoke           also validate <root>/smoke/<id>/task.yaml (never counted)
#   --allow-partial   skip the four-by-four type count (Sprint 258 state)
#   --suite-file F    suite yaml (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml): arm ids
#                     for the leakage check, arms' task_types, suite_version
#
# Checks (each violation is one stdout line `<task-id>: <reason>`):
#   1. schema: id (= directory name), schema_version 1, type (feature-build |
#      bug-fix | refactor | review-catch), source {kind, date, fix_commit?,
#      base_commit?, bead?, origin?, churn?} (churn: {files, insertions,
#      deletions}, non-negative integers; Sprint 259), post_cutoff (bool), fixture (dir under the
#      root; null only for review-catch), criterion (agent-facing; no path, file
#      name or test name), success_criterion, test_command (array; null only for
#      review-catch), regression_command (array | null), reference_patch (hidden/…
#      | null; required for bug-fix and feature-build), grader_protected (array of
#      relative paths present in the fixture; for build types it lists every file
#      under fixture/tests/, Sprint 259), structural_check (hidden/… | null;
#      refactor: regression_command must be null — test_command is the regression check),
#      required for refactor), bounds {max_turns{}, timeout_min{}} (phase → positive
#      int), review_catch (null, or {fixture, manifest, labels?} for review-catch,
#      both present), suite_version (= the suite file's), TASK.md present
#   2. counts: four tasks of each type under tasks/ (unless --allow-partial)
#   3. allowlist: test_command[0] and regression_command[0] in python3 | pytest |
#      bats | bash | node | npx
#   4. hidden/manifest.json (build types): {"files": [{src, dest}]}; every src
#      exists under hidden/; every dest is relative, inside the tree, no `..`
#   5. fixture path rule (build types): check_fixture_path_rule from
#      lib/sandbox-mount.sh — no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires/
#      or .run/ at the fixture's top level; the reference patch touches none either
#   6. leakage: TASK.md and criterion (the task-brief text is built from these)
#      and every phase prompt under evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts/ contain none
#      of: the string `hidden` (any case), a hidden test file's stem, a defect id
#      of the review manifest, a `D[0-9]{2}-` key, an arm id of the suite file
#   7. suite file: every non-absent arm's task_types are known (all | build |
#      review-catch | feature-build | bug-fix | refactor)
#   8. suite file arms (cycle-131 FR-5): `toggles` is a mapping whose every key is in
#      the vocabulary of lib/sandbox-mount.sh apply_arm_toggles with a value it defines
#      (companion_voice, karpathy_block, rule_files, audit_delta_instruction, loa_mount,
#      gates, flatline, sprint_plan, context_resets, dissent: false; effort:
#      low|medium|high|xhigh|max; bare_model: fable; oracle_open: true); `took_effect`
#      is a list whose every id is a rule took-effect.sh defines (its `rule_<id>()`
#      functions, read from the script beside this one); `eval_only`, when present, is
#      a boolean; an arm whose toggles set oracle_open: true carries eval_only: true
#
# Exit: 0 valid; 1 violations (every one listed); 2 usage / unreadable input.
# Tested by evals/tests/validate-suite.bats.
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
SUITE_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
PROMPTS_DIR="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts}"
SMOKE=false ALLOW_PARTIAL=false

usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,55p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
die() { echo "validate-suite: $*" >&2; exit 2; }

def oracle_reason(row):
    """report 1.3: why a row leaves the oracle-exposed sensitivity (non-empty oracle_exposed_defects or
    oracle_exposed_unknown); None for a clean row and for an arm whose evidence says oracle_open (reported,
    never excluded)"""
    ex = [x for x in (row.get("oracle_exposed_defects") or []) if isinstance(x, str)]
    unk = [x for x in (row.get("oracle_exposed_unknown") or []) if isinstance(x, str)]

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# validate-suite.sh — cycle-130 ablation task-suite validator (SDD §3.2, DEC-0424)
#
# Checks every task of the ablation-2.0 suite before it is frozen, run or graded.
#
# Usage:
#   validate-suite.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
#
#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0); the
#                     tasks are <root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml
#   --smoke           also validate <root>/smoke/<id>/task.yaml (never counted)
#   --allow-partial   skip the four-by-four type count (Sprint 258 state)
#   --suite-file F    suite yaml (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml): arm ids
#                     for the leakage check, arms' task_types, suite_version
#
# Checks (each violation is one stdout line `<task-id>: <reason>`):
#   1. schema: id (= directory name), schema_version 1, type (feature-build |
#      bug-fix | refactor | review-catch), source {kind, date, fix_commit?,
#      base_commit?, bead?, origin?, churn?} (churn: {files, insertions,
#      deletions}, non-negative integers; Sprint 259), post_cutoff (bool), fixture (dir under the
#      root; null only for review-catch), criterion (agent-facing; no path, file
#      name or test name), success_criterion, test_command (array; null only for
#      review-catch), regression_command (array | null), reference_patch (hidden/…
#      | null; required for bug-fix and feature-build), grader_protected (array of
#      relative paths present in the fixture; for build types it lists every file
#      under fixture/tests/, Sprint 259), structural_check (hidden/… | null;
#      refactor: regression_command must be null — test_command is the regression check),
#      required for refactor), bounds {max_turns{}, timeout_min{}} (phase → positive
#      int), review_catch (null, or {fixture, manifest, labels?} for review-catch,
#      both present), suite_version (= the suite file's), TASK.md present
#   2. counts: four tasks of each type under tasks/ (unless --allow-partial)
#   3. allowlist: test_command[0] and regression_command[0] in python3 | pytest |
#      bats | bash | node | npx
#   4. hidden/manifest.json (build types): {"files": [{src, dest}]}; every src
#      exists under hidden/; every dest is relative, inside the tree, no `..`
#   5. fixture path rule (build types): check_fixture_path_rule from
#      lib/sandbox-mount.sh — no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires/
#      or .run/ at the fixture's top level; the reference patch touches none either
#   6. leakage: TASK.md and criterion (the task-brief text is built from these)
#      and every phase prompt under evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts/ contain none
#      of: the string `hidden` (any case), a hidden test file's stem, a defect id
#      of the review manifest, a `D[0-9]{2}-` key, an arm id of the suite file
#   7. suite file: every non-absent arm's task_types are known (all | build |
#      review-catch | feature-build | bug-fix | refactor)
#   8. suite file arms (cycle-131 FR-5): `toggles` is a mapping whose every key is in
#      the vocabulary of lib/sandbox-mount.sh apply_arm_toggles with a value it defines
#      (companion_voice, karpathy_block, rule_files, audit_delta_instruction, loa_mount,
#      gates, flatline, sprint_plan, context_resets, dissent: false; effort:
#      low|medium|high|xhigh|max; bare_model: fable; oracle_open: true); `took_effect`
#      is a list whose every id is a rule took-effect.sh defines (its `rule_<id>()`
#      functions, read from the script beside this one); `eval_only`, when present, is
#      a boolean; an arm whose toggles set oracle_open: true carries eval_only: true
#
# Exit: 0 valid; 1 violations (every one listed); 2 usage / unreadable input.
# Tested by evals/tests/validate-suite.bats.
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
SUITE_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
PROMPTS_DIR="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts}"
SMOKE=false ALLOW_PARTIAL=false

usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,55p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
die() { echo "validate-suite: $*" >&2; exit 2; }

# it prints violations, and `FIXTURE\t<id>\t<dir>` lines for the path rule below.
python3 -I - "$WORK/tasks.tsv" "$WORK/suite.json" "$ROOT" "$REPO_ROOT" "$ALLOW_PARTIAL" "$PROMPTS_DIR" "$RULE_IDS" > "$WORK/out.txt" <<'PY' || { cat "$WORK/out.txt" >&2 2>/dev/null; die "validator crashed"; }
import json, os, re, sys

tasks_tsv, suite_json, root, repo, allow_partial, prompts_dir, rule_ids = sys.argv[1:8]
RULE_IDS = set(r for r in rule_ids.split(",") if r)
allow_partial = allow_partial == "true"
suite = json.load(open(suite_json))
out = []
def bad(tid, msg): out.append(f"{tid}: {msg}")

TYPES = ["feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor", "review-catch"]
BUILD = {"feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor"}
ALLOW = {"python3", "pytest", "bats", "bash", "node", "npx"}
KNOWN_TASK_TYPES = {"all", "build", "review-catch", "feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor"}
# lib/sandbox-mount.sh apply_arm_toggles: the toggle vocabulary and each toggle's defined values
TOGGLE_VALUES = {k: [False] for k in ("companion_voice", "karpathy_block", "rule_files", "audit_delta_instruction",
                                      "loa_mount", "gates", "flatline", "sprint_plan", "context_resets", "dissent")}
TOGGLE_VALUES.update({"effort": ["low", "medium", "high", "xhigh", "max"], "bare_model": ["fable"], "oracle_open": [True]})
MOUNT_OWNED = (".claude", "CLAUDE.md", ".loa.config.yaml", "grimoires", ".run")
REQUIRED = ["id", "schema_version", "type", "source", "post_cutoff", "fixture", "criterion",
            "success_criterion", "test_command", "regression_command", "reference_patch",
            "grader_protected", "structural_check", "bounds", "review_catch", "suite_version"]

arms = [a for a in (suite.get("arms") or []) if isinstance(a, dict)]
arm_ids = sorted({a.get("id") for a in arms if isinstance(a.get("id"), str)})
for a in arms:
    if a.get("absent") is True:
        continue
    tt = a.get("task_types")
    if not isinstance(tt, list) or not tt:
        bad("suite", f"arm {a.get('id')} has no task_types list")
        continue
    for t in tt:
        if t not in KNOWN_TASK_TYPES:
            bad("suite", f"arm {a.get('id')} task_types names unknown type '{t}'")
for a in arms:
    if a.get("absent") is True:
        continue
    aid = a.get("id")
    tg = a.get("toggles", {})
    if not isinstance(tg, dict):
        bad("suite", f"arm {aid} toggles must be a mapping")
        tg = {}
    for k, v in tg.items():
        if k not in TOGGLE_VALUES:
            bad("suite", f"arm {aid} names unknown toggle '{k}'")
        elif not any(type(v) is type(x) and v == x for x in TOGGLE_VALUES[k]):   # type-exact: 0 is not false
            bad("suite", f"arm {aid} toggle {k}={json.dumps(v)} is not a defined value ({'|'.join(json.dumps(x) for x in TOGGLE_VALUES[k])})")
    te = a.get("took_effect")
    if not isinstance(te, list) or not all(isinstance(r, str) and r for r in te):
        bad("suite", f"arm {aid} took_effect must be a list of rule ids")
    else:
        for r in te:
            if r not in RULE_IDS:
                bad("suite", f"arm {aid} took_effect names unknown rule id '{r}'")
    if "eval_only" in a and not isinstance(a["eval_only"], bool):
        bad("suite", f"arm {aid} eval_only must be a boolean (true|false)")
    if tg.get("oracle_open") is True and a.get("eval_only") is not True:
        bad("suite", f"arm {aid} sets oracle_open: true without eval_only: true (the open mount is evaluation-only)")
suite_version = suite.get("suite_version")

def rel_ok(p):
    return isinstance(p, str) and p and not p.startswith("/") and ".." not in p.split("/") and "\\" not in p

def is_str_list(v):
    return isinstance(v, list) and all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in v)

def read(p):
    try:
        return open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
    except OSError:
        return None

prompt_texts = []
if os.path.isdir(prompts_dir):
    for f in sorted(os.listdir(prompts_dir)):
        if f.endswith(".md"):
            prompt_texts.append((f"phase-prompts/{f}", read(os.path.join(prompts_dir, f)) or ""))

content.text:
The review is written to `/workspace/review.md` with verdict **CHANGES_REQUIRED**.

**What I checked.** The eval_only refusal in pipeline-run.sh sits before the run directory is created, honours only the exact value `1`, and run-ablation.sh sets the variable on the trial command alone, so the agent never sees it (the executor runs under `env -i`). The help and usage line ranges were bumped correctly. The validator's toggle, took_effect and eval_only checks match their tests.

**Findings, in order of weight:**

- **Report decisions are structurally broken for the new arms.** The three review-catch-only arms become components, but the report's primaries for any review-catch arm include hidden_test_pass_rate, which has no build tasks to pair for them. Every decision therefore carries a "no valid pair" clause, so remove and simplify can never be reached for these arms.
- **The eval_only arm's rows vanish from the report.** They enter the cells and count in row totals, cap failures and budget figures, but appear in no decision, per-arm detail, or listed section. The open-versus-closed comparison the arm exists for is never rendered.
- **Priority list not updated.** The suite's `priority` omits all four new arms, so the runner's default plan never schedules them. Either intended and undocumented, or a defect.
- **Scope mismatch with the title.** The title promises a cycle-131 suite root with bounds 50/40 and an image self-check. None of that is in the diff.
- **Minor.** A stale "6 components" comment in the suite, and the dry-run output duplicates the mount library's toggle-to-config mapping in inline jq, which will drift.

**Not verifiable here.** The real `lib/sandbox-mount.sh` and `took-effect.sh` are not in the PR, so I could not confirm the dissent toggle mapping or that the five new took-effect rule ids exist. The VS-16 test asserts the latter against the repository.
